messages.author: 16f43467e4ee3f24
messages.subject: Analysis Details window blank
parts:
Hi everybody,

I am new to Distance Sampling. I followed the User's Guide with examples. Everything went normal, except that I could not see any output in the Analysis Details window. Both Log and Results pages were blank. I tried other sample projects, and the problem remained the same. 

How I can fix the problem?

Thanks to all.

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Analysis Details window blank
parts:
This is an issue that has come up several times on the Distance list (most recently in 2012) and is discussed in the Distance users guide, in the Appendix called 'Program Reference' under 'Preferences Dialog.'

This is because Distance tries to compress these results, and the compression algorithm does not work with various Asian character sets.  There is a way to fix this:  Under 'Tools' on the menu, select Preferences.  On the tab marked 'General' untick the box labelled 'Store results in compressed format in project databases'  This will prevent the use of compression software that alters Chinese/Japanese/Korean languages.

Above taken from this previous message: 

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/distance-sampling/z6zSXa1YqtY/AMJmW5ezszsJ;context-place=searchin/distance-sampling/%22log$20and$20results%22%7Csort:relevance

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Analysis Details window blank
parts:
Sam

The only reason I can think of for the results window (not tab) to be blank after an analysis is due to the compression software incompatibility with the language settings of the operating system.  The remedy for this is as described previously:

Under 'Tools' on the menu, select Preferences.  On the tab marked 'General' untick the box labelled 'Store results in compressed format in project databases'  This will prevent the use of compression software that alters Chinese/Japanese/Korean languages.

Can you confirm that

a) your language preferences in the operating system are set to one of these languages, and

b) you have reset the "Store results in compressed format in project databases" is unchecked?

If you still have an issue, please use File | Export to create a zip file of the project that is causing the problem and send it along to me.

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Analysis Details window blank
parts:
Hi Eric,

I was getting the same blank analysis results although the summary results would show up in the Analyses Window (albeit one of the analyses did not run but did after the fix).  Everything worked on my older Macbook pro with Distance 7.2 running under Parallels 10/Wiindows 10 but I'd just upgraded to Parallels 14 (same set up) on my newer Macbook Pro, which had the blank results issue.  All settings in MacOs and Windows 10 were for English, but following the advice here worked!  Not enough of a Parallels wiz to know if it has some sort of language setting but since Distance ran fine with Parallels 10, the culprit is probably Parallels 14.  I originally found this email thread because we have an UG student from Japan who was getting the blank analysis screen and this fix solved his problem so I thought I'd give it a try and it worked, so thanks!!

So thought I'd post this in case it solves the problem for other issues.

Ken

Fort Collins, CO  80523
